title: Pollutant Explorer Germany
description: Explore one pollutant at a time. The trend compares the ten highest station means as individual lines; the other charts reveal daily and city-level patterns.

list.name: pollutant
list.label: Pollutant
list.query: SELECT component FROM (SELECT DISTINCT component FROM measurements) AS pollutants ORDER BY CASE WHEN component = 'PM2.5' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, component;

list.name: city
list.label: City
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT city FROM stations ORDER BY city;

list.name: station
list.label: Station
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT station_name FROM stations WHERE city IN ($city) ORDER BY station_name;

panels.title: Top 10 station trends · $pollutant
panels.description: Each line is one station, ranked by mean over the selected time range. CO is measured in mg/m³; other pollutants are generally reported in µg/m³.

targets.rawSql: WITH top_stations AS (SELECT s.station_id, s.city, s.station_name, AVG(m.value) AS ranking_mean FROM measurements AS m JOIN stations AS s USING (station_id) WHERE m.component = '$pollutant' AND $__timeFilter(m.timestamp) AND s.city IN ($city) AND s.station_name IN ($station) GROUP BY s.station_id,s.city,s.station_name ORDER BY ranking_mean DESC LIMIT 10) SELECT m.timestamp AS time, ts.city || ' · ' || ts.station_name AS metric, AVG(m.value)::double precision AS value FROM measurements AS m JOIN top_stations ts USING (station_id) WHERE m.component = '$pollutant' AND $__timeFilter(m.timestamp) GROUP BY m.timestamp, ts.city, ts.station_name ORDER BY time;

panels.title: Daily cycle · mean by hour
panels.description: Average reading by hour of day across the selected period. Values are not normalized; CO is in mg/m³, other pollutants generally µg/m³.

targets.rawSql: SELECT TO_CHAR(EXTRACT(HOUR FROM m.timestamp), 'FM00') || ':00' AS hour, AVG(m.value)::double precision AS mean_value FROM measurements m JOIN stations s USING (station_id) WHERE m.component = '$pollutant' AND $__timeFilter(m.timestamp) AND s.city IN ($city) AND s.station_name IN ($station) GROUP BY EXTRACT(HOUR FROM m.timestamp) ORDER BY EXTRACT(HOUR FROM m.timestamp);

panels.title: Highest city means · $pollutant
panels.description: Top city-level means for the selected pollutant and time range; city/station filters apply. CO is in mg/m³, other pollutants generally µg/m³.

targets.rawSql: SELECT s.city AS city, AVG(m.value)::double precision AS mean_value FROM measurements m JOIN stations s USING (station_id) WHERE m.component = '$pollutant' AND $__timeFilter(m.timestamp) AND s.city IN ($city) AND s.station_name IN ($station) GROUP BY s.city ORDER BY mean_value DESC LIMIT 10;
